_comment:
'Your next Runeblade or Lightning attack this turn gets +1{p}. Create a Lightning Flow token. Go again'.

One PLAY ability, effects in printed order.

PUMP: MODIFY_NEXT_ATTACK (handler effect_types.py:4592-4618 reads mod/amount/filter/scope) queues a one-shot on the controller's dsl_queued_attack_mods; engine._apply_turn_attack_effects consumes it on the first attack whose card matches the filter and leaves it queued otherwise, so a non-matching attack does not burn the +1 - exact 'next Runeblade or Lightning attack' semantics. Unused entries expire at end of turn.

'Runeblade OR Lightning' as ONE ATTACK_CLASS_IN with two entries - deliberate simplification of triage's OR(ATTACK_CLASS_IN / CARD_IS_TALENT): the handler reads classes/class/talent/talents keys and matches against _card_traits(attack_card), which unions CLASSES AND TALENTS (condition_types.py:204-216, whose own comment cites the talents trap). Runeblade is a class, Lightning is a talent; one condition covers both, so no OR wrapper is needed. Weapons attack as themselves, so a Lightning-talented weapon attack matches too.

TOKEN: CREATE_TOKEN (handler effect_types.py:1942-2013 reads token/count|amount/player/destination); 'lightning_flow' is already the slug of json/tokens/lightning_flow.json, which EXISTS, so no destination param is needed - zone routing derives from the template subtypes. Default count 1, default controller SELF.

GoAgain is in printed_keywords: it fires from the card DB keywords field and is deliberately NOT authored here (re-authoring a printed keyword is a defect). No known gaps.
